content: Pathlight School is an educational institution in Singapore specifically designed to cater to the needs of children with autism. It began operations in January 2004 and currently accommodates over 240 students, ranging in age from 6 to 16 years old. In addition to delivering a mainstream academic curriculum within an autism-friendly environment, Pathlight School provides specialized educational programs. These programs are tailored to equip students with autism and related disorders with essential life skills, enabling them to navigate daily living and social interactions more effectively. In January 2006, Pathlight School launched a unique initiative called Café @ Pathlight, a specialized Starbucks café. This facility was established to teach students aged 12 to 15 fundamental work and life skills in a practical setting. To ensure the success of this program, volunteers and staff from Pathlight School underwent an intensive 3to 4-week training program conducted by Starbucks. This training enabled them to acquire the necessary skills and knowledge, which they could subsequently pass on to the students. The construction of this café required an investment of 5 million Singapore dollars.
